quote: A person shall not open the door of or board or alight from the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic.

activation.condition: Observed selected person opens, boards or alights on the side closest to passing traffic while other traffic moves.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Interference is a legal judgment; retain original act, door/body clearance, movement and response.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic

obligation.description: Do not perform the specified act in a manner that interferes with moving vehicular traffic.

timing.description: Join original driver act and moving traffic in the same Native frames.
